Vetted people and groups can receive access through the Cyber Verification Program or the Life Sciences Verification Program. Mythos 5.1 also powers Claude Security, a tool that scans collections of code, finds possible security problems, and suggests repairs for a person to review. Here, stronger access depends on trust and purpose.

blk_part_03_part_3_gpt_6_astra_can_act_o.text: Its cyber ability also created serious risk. Under OpenAI’s Preparedness Framework, GPT-6 Astra was the first OpenAI model to reach the Critical cybersecurity capability level. With suitable tools and access, it can find previously unknown security weaknesses and develop ways to use them against many well-protected systems without a person directing every step. OpenAI therefore added stronger safeguards and monitoring. Access began with cyber defenders in the Daybreak program, while wider ChatGPT and API access was planned for the following days.
